items.summary: Enforce a 20-minute cooldown on the Spin the Wheel feature in the backend. After a user spins, record the timestamp of their last spin and prevent another spin until 20 minutes have elapsed. Return the remaining cooldown time to the frontend so it can display a countdown.

In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), display a disabled spin button with a countdown timer showing the remaining time (MM:SS) when the user is in cooldown. Re-enable the button automatically once the 20-minute cooldown expires.

When points are won on the Spin the Wheel, add them exclusively to the Virtual Pet's points/experience in the backend (e.g., the VirtualPetHub record). Do not add spin-wheel points to any other score field or reward bucket.

In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), after a spin that yields points, call only the mutation that updates the Virtual Pet with the earned points. Do not call any other reward or score mutation for point outcomes.
